versions.content: Invalid configuration of RunnableEntityArgument with incom- patible array types Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00072, SRS_Rte_00029 The RTE Generator shall reject a configuration if • a RunnableEntityArgument is present AND • the ImplementationDataType of the RunnableEntityArgument resolves to an Array Implementation Data Type AND • the serverArgumentImplPolicy of the RunnableEntityArgument is set to useArrayBaseType AND • the base element type of the type of the serverArgumentImplPolicy is not compatible with the base element type of the ImplementationDataType of the RunnableEntityArgument .
